A '''concussion projectile launcher''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] armament around [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]]. They could be found on [[Vaya-class scout|''Vaya''-class scout ships]], such as [[Andur Sunrider]]'s ''[[Lightside Explorer]]''.<ref name="TOTJ: Companion">''[[Tales of the Jedi Companion]]''</ref>
